item.title: Show HN: AmitabhC – a programming language made of Amitabh Bachchan dialogues
item.summary: Hi HN! Amitabh Bachchan is Indian cinema's biggest icon - five decades of films whose dialogues everyone in India can quote from memory. I built a programming language where those films and dialogues are the language. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49320178 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
